description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): write one tenant's mesh grants, routes and exit-node setting (PUT /api/v1/connect/policies/:id) from a connect.policy@1. The tenant in the body must be the caller's tenant; a rule or route naming another tenant's device is refused. Exit-node traffic is opened only to this tenant's devices and never to a public share. A write bumps the policy version the devices apply.
